_comment: DATA-DRIVEN concept->icon map (WO concept-icon). A conceptId (abilityId / skillId / effect / itemId / owner concept token, lower-cased) maps to a real sprite addressed by { role, name, override? } in RpgUiCatalog (role 'icons' = Resources/RpgUi/icons/*, role 'potion' = Resources/RpgUi/potion/*, etc.). ConceptIconResolver loads this once and returns RpgUiCatalog.Get(role,name); a missing art file yields null so the caller keeps its glyph/class-art fallback. OPTIONAL per-entry boolean 'override' (default false/absent): when true the concept FORCES its Obsidian icon over a caller's own richer art (the defaults bar uses ResolveAnyOverride -> class art -> ResolveAny gap-fill). Leave override absent to keep today's behavior (class art wins on the defaults bar). This file is the SINGLE source of the mapping  -  no icon choices live in C#. Edit here to re-skin/override any concept. Real icons present today: icon_combat, icon_sword, icon_shield, icon_heart, icon_inventory, icon_quest, icon_compass, icon_talk, icon_tree, icon_settings. WO-681: role 'spellicons' = the Blink 500 RPG Spell Icons library mirrored by DeNelle.Editor.BlinkIconImporter into Resources/RpgUi/spellicons/<ArchetypeGroup>/<Class>/<Class><N> (plus roles 'emblem' = 25 class emblems, 'classslot' = themed action-bar slot frames). Icon names are class+number (e.g. Guardian13); every spellicons choice below was picked by SILHOUETTE/SHAPE (owner is red/green colorblind  -  never by color): arrows-stuck-in-shield=taunt, warrior-under-ward-dome=invuln, boot=dash, bear-trap=snare, arrow-volley=volley, sky-bolt=thunderbolt, burning-brand=ember dot, hands-channeling-light=heal, descending-light-rays=heal-over-time, axe-sweep-arc=cleave, slash-whirl=combo, roaring-figure=roar, radial-shockwave-figure=aoe, hammer-smiting-from-sky=meteor/radiant ult, spearhead=throwing spear, purple-dart=arcane bolt, radiant-suffused-figure=second wind, glowing-mended-figure=mend, shield-ram=bash, recurve-bow-with-nocked-arrow=bow shot (WO-1105 ranger.q Quick Shot, the archer's action-bar bow ability, owner ruling 2026-08-16). ICON-CATALOG WIRE-UP (2026-08-16): the MAGE authored NO ability-id row at all, so all four medallions fell through to their effect and rendered KNIGHT iconography - q 'strike' -> abilities/attack_sword (a sword under the caption 'Cast'), w 'shield' -> icons/icon_shield, e 'drainshot' (unmapped) -> the icon_combat crossed-swords default, r 'dot' -> Pyromancer1 (a fire staff, for a POISON ultimate). 'verb' is NEVER consulted for an icon (HudModelProducers.cs:594 passes only id+effect to ConceptIconResolver.ResolveKey), so only an id row can fix this. TWO rows are added here because their silhouette is a LITERAL depiction of the ability's named subject, not an interpretation - mage.fireball -> Pyromancer18 (the only icon in the mirrored set that is a BALL OF FIRE with a comet trail; Pyromancer11 is a zigzag BOLT ending in an orb, a different shape) and mage.shell -> Arcanist12 (the only arcane SHIELD/ward face in either Elementalist family). mage.drain and mage.poison are DELIBERATELY LEFT UNAUTHORED pending an owner tag: no mirrored icon literally depicts life-drain or a poison cloud, so every candidate is an interpretation and picking one is the creative choice the owner-tags-the-art rule forbids the CLI to make. A THIRD row, mage.arcane-bolt -> Arcanist6, is NOT a new pick: 'universal.arcane-bolt' was ALREADY tagged Arcanist6 (the 'purple-dart=arcane bolt' entry above), and mage.arcane-bolt is that same named concept under a class-scoped id, so it merely stops the identical spell rendering abilities/attack_sword because its id missed by a prefix. WO-1195 OWNER ART RULINGS (2026-08-26, chosen off the 96px contact sheet): food -> the distinct 332x321 HudIcons art recut into currency/currency_food (the old 1200px agribusiness LOGO was illegible at chip size and failed greyscale by being unreadable, not by hue); magic -> the Arcanist emblem (the aether shard was DISQUALIFIED - silhouette-identical to the crystal chip); wisdom -> the spellbook tome; stone KEPT AS-IS. CurrencyKind.Food resolves the concept 'stone', never 'food' - canon sec.7 retired Food for Stone and the town rail labels that slot 'Stone', so the enum name is NOT the concept id (ElarionUiKit.ConceptIdFor is the one translator). mage.thunder is deliberately NOT bound to knight.thunderbolt's Electromancer9 - abilities.json already rules verbatim that reusing that ability's look-alike keys 'is exactly the creative pick the rule forbids'. WO-1294 ONE-ICON IDENTITY PROPAGATION (2026-09-02): the SHARED/universal pool was re-tagged in talent-icon-map.json (WO-1023) and this file was never followed, so a skill showed one picture on its talent-tree node and a DIFFERENT one in the hot-swap slot and combat HUD - the exact split section 4 of WO-1294 forbids. Four rows are re-pointed at the art the tree already authors, so NO new creative pick is made here; every value is copied from the matching talent-icon-map blinkSource: universal.arcane-bolt Arcanist6 -> Arcanist17 (shared.n9 blinkSource, 'three streaking bolt projectiles'), universal.mend Paladin15 -> Priest5 (shared.n10), universal.dash Deathknight11 -> Rogue4 (shared.n11). mage.arcane-bolt follows to Arcanist17 for the reason already recorded above - it is the SAME named concept as universal.arcane-bolt and was only ever tagged Arcanist6 because that is what universal.arcane-bolt then carried; leaving it behind would have re-created the split it was added to close. The knock-on fix is that Arcanist6 now belongs to mage.manaweave ALONE (its own tree node, mage.t2n2, already authors Arcanist6), so a mage no longer sees Manaweave and Arcane Bolt as the identical purple dart. STILL UNAUTHORED, needs an owner tag: mage.heal and universal.mend are two different heals both literally named 'Mend' and both now resolve Priest5 - they are simultaneously placeable for a mage, and separating them means PICKING art, which is the creative call the owner-tags-the-art rule reserves. Pinned from here on by ConceptIconIdentityRegression [concept-icons].
_actionBarFaceNote: WO-1359 action-bar faces: 'path' is an OPTIONAL sprite address tried BEFORE role/name. It is either a plain Resources sprite path or '<sheet Resources path>#<face name>' - a NAME-KEYED slice of an owner-authored sheet, cut by SpriteSheetSlices from the normalized rects in the sheet's sibling actionbar-emblems.json manifest (itself derived from the sheet's own alpha bounding boxes). The key here equals the face caption lower-cased and the manifest is keyed by the same name, so re-ordering a sheet can never hand MANAGE the JOURNEY emblem. If the art or the manifest is missing the row falls through to the role/name pack art and the bar renders exactly as it did before - a missing icon is never a missing button.
